stories.headline: 16 killed, 32 injured in magnitude 7 earthquake in Tibet; rescue ops under way
stories.title: 16 killed, 32 injured in magnitude 7 earthquake in Tibet; rescue ops under way
stories.summary: Police and fire department personnel have been working to rescue people and provide temporary shelter to those who had lost their homes. Rescue teams were also putting up tents to accommodate residents displaced by the earthquake. According to the United States Geological Survey (USGS), the earthquake occurred at 10.33 pm local time.

stories.headline: Election petitions cannot be filed merely on the basis of videos downloaded from internet: Madras High Court
stories.title: Election petitions cannot be filed merely on the basis of videos downloaded from internet: Madras High Court
stories.summary: Justice G.K. Ilanthiraiyan says there must also be independent documentary material to establish returned candidate’s alleged involvement in corrupt practices
reasons: corroboration: single independent source -> medium confidence
article_sentences: An election petition cannot be filed merely on the basis of videos downloaded from the internet without there being any independent documentary material to establish the returned candidate’s alleged involvement in corrupt practices, the Madras High Court has held.

Justice G.K. Ilanthiraiyan passed the ruling while rejecting an election petition filed by a DMK advocate’s wing office-bearer, in his capacity as a voter, challenging the victory of AIADMK former Minister C.Ve.
Shanmugam from Mailam Assembly constituency in the 2026 general elections.
Mr. Shanmugam had won the seat by securing 82,533 votes as against 52,312 votes secured by his nearest rival candidate.
However, P. Kamalakkannan of Tindivanam had filed the election petition accusing the MLA of having indulged in electoral corrupt practices.
The petitioner alleged that the returned candidate had paid cash of ₹1,000 each to several voters in Kongarapattu village besides issuing coupons promising payment of ₹2,000 each to every voter.
He relied upon video recordings to contend that the money was paid with the consent of the MLA.
On the other hand, urging the court to reject the election petition, the MLA said, the petitioner had failed to disclose to the court that he was a member of the DMK advocate’s wing.
The MLA also stated that the videos had been downloaded from the internet without ascertaining their authenticity and reliability.
After hearing both sides, the judge wrote: “The election petitioner had no personal knowledge of any of the allegations leveled in the election petition.
The allegations were made solely on the basis of information received from certain persons and a videograph downloaded from the internet...

stories.title: Will back all meaningful efforts for Ukraine peace, PM Modi assures Poland's Tusk

In his media statement, Modi assured Tusk that whether it is Ukraine or West Asia, India will continue to support every meaningful effort for peace.

stories.title: Leaders empowering the next decade
stories.summary: Dr. Sandeep Mahajan: Engineering the Future of Sustainable LivingThe future of housing belongs to leaders who dare to rethink Construction. Dr. Sandeep Mahajan, Founder of Vrisa Innovation Limited is advancing sustainable modular construction for a rapidly evolving India. Established in 2010, Vrisa transforms buildings through CMS-Composite Modular Structures, foldable and expandable prefab homes, and V-PODS-ready-to-use space capsules introduced in 2024.With over 200 structures across India, the company combines rapid delivery, customization, and environmental responsibility. Its achievements include the Udyog Bharati Award, Bhartiya Udyog Ratna Award, Pune Udyog Bhushan Award, Most Trusted Company recognition, and an Honorary Doctorate in Sustainable Construction.Recognised among leading prefab and modular construction companies, Dr. Mahajan champions future-ready sustainable living. As Vrisa expands globally, his leadership remains focused on reshaping construction through innovation, sustainability, and trust.Rohaan Patill: Building the Next Global Trading and Energy Powerhouse In trading, team and trust are everything.Founder and Director of Ace Raysons Global Group and Ace Raysons Helios, Rohaan drives agri-commodity and petroleum trading with government-owned oil corporations, alongside strategic data centre and solar acquisitions.His core team: execution led by Harsh Tripathi, Pankaj Mundada and Saanjay Waje; finance by Rochelle D’Souza, Udit Sachdeva, Manish Kaushik and Arjun Sharma; crude and LPG by former HPCL crude trading head Subhabrata Tripathi, former IOCL CGM Rashmi Dhingra and Rohit Kumar; shipping and logistics by Capt. Pradeep Arora; client coordination by Swastika Mahajan and Jyotin Mehta; and data centres by Satish Kumar and Sandip Kailuke.With two oil blocks already acquired and drilling imminent, the group is now signing a major national cooperative partnership.“I didn’t set out to build a trading company,” Rohaan says. “I set out to build a team people trust with their cargo, because trust is the only commodity that never goes out of season.”Watch this team over the next decade.Rishabh Sobti: Powering Business Continuity with Reliable Power Backup SolutionsIn a world where operational downtime comes at a cost, dependable power is essential to business continuity. At Excel Generators, Rishabh Sobti is building on a 35-year legacy, combining established expertise with a forward-looking approach to power solutions.As a second-generation leader with an MBA in Marketing and HR from IMI Belgium, Sobti brings modern management to the family enterprise founded by Shri Ravi Sobti.Serving organisations across industries, Excel Generators offers pan-India rental, leasing, maintenance and end-to-end power solutions, with capacities ranging from 7.5 kVA to 2,500 kVA. Its client portfolio includes Zomato, Blinkit and Flipkart.Recognised by Industry Outlook as a “Top Company in Generator Rental Services – 2026,” Excel Generators continues to strengthen its service capabilities, guided by reliability, accountability and customer trust.Crest Architects: Defying Gravity, Redefining PossibilitiesAt an age when most architecture students were translating ideas onto paper, Ar. Vishwas Venkat and Ar. Vikas M. V. were already bringing theirs to life. At 20, they began their journey with Floating Walls, a multi-award-winning project that laid the foundation for Crest Architects and a vision unafraid to challenge convention.Since its inception, Crest has pushed the boundaries of architectural expression, carving a distinct identity through cantilevers, structural ingenuity, and sensitivity to context. Each project explores the interplay of architecture, engineering, and human experience, creating spaces that are visually compelling yet grounded in their surroundings.Today, Crest Architects is a sought-after practice, recognised for its architectural language.For Crest, architecture is an experience to be lived, an emotion to be remembered, and a relationship between people and spaces.Bhagyashri Varma, Founder- Noesis Service ConsultantsTrained as an architect but drawn to the systems that work silently behind every wall, Ar. Bhagyashri Varma built Noesis Service Consultants on a simple conviction: that a building’s services belong in its first sketch, never its afterthoughts. Too often, she argues, engineering is squeezed into spaces already drawn, leaving lowered ceilings and costly redesigns during execution, so her firm weaves MEP, fire and life safety, sustainability and compliance into the earliest stages of planning instead.As Indian cities grow denser and every square metre is chased for revenue, her case is that shafts, plant rooms and service corridors are not lost space but performance space, a distinction the buildings of the next decade cannot afford to ignore.Dr. Parth Rana, Medical Director , Netralaya Super Speciality Eye HospitalDr. Parth Rana, a retina and ocular trauma surgeon who completed India's first Ocular Trauma Fellowship, has helped reshape the economics of eye surgery. His Patented Scleral Tuck intraocular lenses, used across India, they brought down time for putting intra ocular lens in complicated cataract surgery time down to 15 minutes, and his latest has reduced it to just five. He has also chosen to forgo royalties so the lenses stay affordable.As medical director of Ahmedabad's Netralaya Super Speciality Eye Hospital, he has brought specialists in retina, glaucoma, cornea, ocular oncology and more under one roof, alongside Gujarat's first 3D Eye surgery system, Ultra wide field Retina imaging System, ultra wide field OCT and many other latest diagnostic equipment first in Gujarat so none of the Gujarat eye patients have to go out of the state to get their eyes treated. The hospital plans a nine-storey centre and free care through government schemes, with the hope that no patient will ever need to leave Gujarat for eye care.Gautham Nekkanti: Strengthening India’s Defence Capabilities Beyond GPSWhen GPS fails, national security cannot afford to. Gautham Nekkanti, Founder and CEO of PhoQtek Labs is building indigenous navigation technology to address one of modern defence’s critical vulnerabilities: operating without satellite signals.Founded in Hyderabad in January 2025, the DPIIT-recognised defence deep-tech company develops GarudaNav, a visual-inertial navigation module for drones, alongside indigenous fibre-optic gyroscope technology.Driven by a long-term commitment to national security, Nekkanti is investing his inherited fortune in advancing India’s defence capabilities. Under his leadership, GarudaNav Core has achieved Technology Readiness Level 7, recorded over 100 cumulative flight-test hours and completed a GPS-denied UAV mission at the Indian Air Force’s Dronathon in September 2026.By combining personal conviction with indigenous innovation, Nekkanti is helping strengthen India’s strategic autonomy and build the next generation of assured navigation systems.Sahil Sanjay Jaggi | Shaping India’s Global FutureSahil Sanjay Jaggi, Director of World One Import Export LLP, is a forward-thinking entrepreneur strengthening India’s presence in global commerce. Leading diversified international trade across ethnic wear, accessories, handicrafts, FMCG, chemicals and industrial products, his company operates as a global sourcing and consolidation partner, connecting Indian manufacturers with international markets. With manufacturing partnerships supporting leading retail stores worldwide, he is building a stronger bridge between Indian capabilities and global demand. His ambitious roadmap spans artificial intelligence, EV, solar energy, advanced manufacturing and technology-driven supply-chain solutions. opening: Dr. Sandeep Mahajan: Engineering the Future of Sustainable Living.
The future of housing belongs to leaders who dare to rethink Construction.
body: Dr. Sandeep Mahajan, Founder of Vrisa Innovation Limited is advancing sustainable modular construction for a rapidly evolving India.
Established in 2010, Vrisa transforms buildings through CMS-Composite Modular Structures, foldable and expandable prefab homes, and V-PODS-ready-to-use space capsules introduced in 2024.
With over 200 structures across India, the company combines rapid delivery, customization, and environmental responsibility.
Its achievements include the Udyog Bharati Award, Bhartiya Udyog Ratna Award, Pune Udyog Bhushan Award, Most Trusted Company recognition, and an Honorary Doctorate in Sustainable Construction.
Recognised among leading prefab and modular construction companies, Dr. Mahajan champions future-ready sustainable living.
As Vrisa expands globally, his leadership remains focused on reshaping construction through innovation, sustainability, and trust.
Rohaan Patill: Building the Next Global Trading and Energy Powerhouse.
In trading, team and trust are everything.

Founder and Director of Ace Raysons Global Group and Ace Raysons Helios, Rohaan drives agri-commodity and petroleum trading with government-owned oil corporations, alongside strategic data centre and solar acquisitions.

His core team: execution led by Harsh Tripathi, Pankaj Mundada and Saanjay Waje; finance by Rochelle D’Souza, Udit Sachdeva, Manish Kaushik and Arjun Sharma; crude and LPG by former HPCL crude trading head Subhabrata Tripathi, former IOCL CGM Rashmi Dhingra and Rohit Kumar; shipping and logistics by Capt. Pradeep Arora; client coordination by Swastika Mahajan and Jyotin Mehta; and data centres by Satish Kumar and Sandip Kailuke.
With two oil blocks already acquired and drilling imminent, the group is now signing a major national cooperative partnership.
“I didn’t set out to build a trading company,” Rohaan says.
“I set out to build a team people trust with their cargo, because trust is the only commodity that never goes out of season.” Watch this team over the next decade.
Rishabh Sobti: Powering Business Continuity with Reliable Power Backup Solutions.
In a world where operational downtime comes at a cost, dependable power is essential to business continuity.
At Excel Generators, Rishabh Sobti is building on a 35-year legacy, combining established expertise with a forward-looking approach to power solutions.
As a second-generation leader with an MBA in Marketing and HR from IMI Belgium, Sobti brings modern management to the family enterprise founded by Shri Ravi Sobti.
Serving organisations across industries, Excel Generators offers pan-India rental, leasing, maintenance and end-to-end power solutions, with capacities ranging from 7.5 kVA to 2,500 kVA.
Its client portfolio includes Zomato, Blinkit and Flipkart.
Crest Architects: Defying Gravity, Redefining Possibilities.
At an age when most architecture students were translating ideas onto paper, Ar.
Vishwas Venkat and Ar.
Vikas M. V. were already bringing theirs to life.
At 20, they began their journey with Floating Walls, a multi-award-winning project that laid the foundation for Crest Architects and a vision unafraid to challenge convention.
Since its inception, Crest has pushed the boundaries of architectural expression, carving a distinct identity through cantilevers, structural ingenuity, and sensitivity to context.
Each project explores the interplay of architecture, engineering, and human experience, creating spaces that are visually compelling yet grounded in their surroundings.
Today, Crest Architects is a sought-after practice, recognised for its architectural language.
For Crest, architecture is an experience to be lived, an emotion to be remembered, and a relationship between people and spaces.
Bhagyashri Varma, Founder- Noesis Service ConsultantsTrained as an architect but drawn to the systems that work silently behind every wall, Ar.
Bhagyashri Varma built Noesis Service Consultants on a simple conviction: that a building’s services belong in its first sketch, never its afterthoughts.

Too often, she argues, engineering is squeezed into spaces already drawn, leaving lowered ceilings and costly redesigns during execution, so her firm weaves MEP, fire and life safety, sustainability and compliance into the earliest stages of planning instead.

As Indian cities grow denser and every square metre is chased for revenue, her case is that shafts, plant rooms and service corridors are not lost space but performance space, a distinction the buildings of the next decade cannot afford to ignore.
Dr. Parth Rana, Medical Director, Netralaya Super Speciality Eye HospitalDr.
Parth Rana, a retina and ocular trauma surgeon who completed India's first Ocular Trauma Fellowship, has helped reshape the economics of eye surgery.

His Patented Scleral Tuck intraocular lenses, used across India, they brought down time for putting intra ocular lens in complicated cataract surgery time down to 15 minutes, and his latest has reduced it to just five.
He has also chosen to forgo royalties so the lenses stay affordable.

As medical director of Ahmedabad's Netralaya Super Speciality Eye Hospital, he has brought specialists in retina, glaucoma, cornea, ocular oncology and more under one roof, alongside Gujarat's first 3D Eye surgery system, Ultra wide field Retina imaging System, ultra wide field OCT and many other latest diagnostic equipment first in Gujarat so none of the Gujarat eye patients have to go out of the state to get their eyes treated.
The hospital plans a nine-storey centre and free care through government schemes, with the hope that no patient will ever need to leave Gujarat for eye care.
Gautham Nekkanti: Strengthening India’s Defence Capabilities Beyond GPSWhen GPS fails, national security cannot afford to.
Gautham Nekkanti, Founder and CEO of PhoQtek Labs is building indigenous navigation technology to address one of modern defence’s critical vulnerabilities: operating without satellite signals.

Founded in Hyderabad in January 2025, the DPIIT-recognised defence deep-tech company develops GarudaNav, a visual-inertial navigation module for drones, alongside indigenous fibre-optic gyroscope technology.
Driven by a long-term commitment to national security, Nekkanti is investing his inherited fortune in advancing India’s defence capabilities.

Under his leadership, GarudaNav Core has achieved Technology Readiness Level 7, recorded over 100 cumulative flight-test hours and completed a GPS-denied UAV mission at the Indian Air Force’s Dronathon in September 2026.
By combining personal conviction with indigenous innovation, Nekkanti is helping strengthen India’s strategic autonomy and build the next generation of assured navigation systems.
Sahil Sanjay Jaggi | Shaping India’s Global FutureSahil Sanjay Jaggi, Director of World.
One Import Export LLP, is a forward-thinking entrepreneur strengthening India’s presence in global commerce.

Leading diversified international trade across ethnic wear, accessories, handicrafts, FMCG, chemicals and industrial products, his company operates as a global sourcing and consolidation partner, connecting Indian manufacturers with international markets.
With manufacturing partnerships supporting leading retail stores worldwide, he is building a stronger bridge between Indian capabilities and global demand.
His ambitious roadmap spans artificial intelligence, EV, solar energy, advanced manufacturing and technology-driven supply-chain solutions.

Inspired by Make in India, Sahil is advancing initiatives that strengthen domestic industries, create opportunities for Indian manufacturers and emerging businesses, and position India as a global force in innovation, manufacturing and international trade.
